With the society entrance blocked, Daya comes up with an Ahmedabad-style solution using a large spare tire, ropes, and a pulley system. After Daya tests the ride, Dr. Parulekar reluctantly sits on the tire and is pulled over the gate, successfully treating Iyer with a pain-relief injection—only for the overhead rod to snap, trapping the doctor inside.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
